description: Test harness for trigger handling in openclaw project, including mocks, environment setup, and test utility functions.

methods.name: getSharedMocks
methods.description: Creates or retrieves shared mock objects stored in globalThis, keyed by a string.

methods.name: getAbortEmbeddedPiRunMock
methods.description: Returns the mock function for abortEmbeddedPiRun.

methods.name: getCompactEmbeddedPiSessionMock
methods.description: Returns the mock function for compactEmbeddedPiSession.

methods.name: getRunEmbeddedPiAgentMock
methods.description: Returns the mock function for runEmbeddedPiAgent.

methods.name: getQueueEmbeddedPiMessageMock
methods.description: Returns the mock function for queueEmbeddedPiMessage.

methods.name: installPiEmbeddedMock
methods.description: Mocks the '../agents/pi-embedded.js' module with predefined mock functions.

methods.name: getProviderUsageMocks
methods.description: Returns the provider usage mock functions.

methods.name: installModelCatalogMock
methods.description: Mocks the '../agents/model-catalog.js' module with predefined mock functions.

methods.name: getModelCatalogMocks
methods.description: Returns the model catalog mock functions.

methods.name: installModelFallbackMock
methods.description: Mocks the '../agents/model-fallback.js' module with predefined mock functions.

methods.name: getModelFallbackMocks
methods.description: Returns the model fallback mock functions.

methods.name: loadGetReplyFromConfig
methods.description: Dynamically imports and returns the getReplyFromConfig function from './reply.js'.

methods.name: installTriggerHandlingReplyHarness
methods.description: Sets up test hooks to load reply configuration and install E2E test hooks.

methods.name: requireSessionStorePath
methods.description: Retrieves the session store path from configuration, throws if missing.

methods.name: readSessionStore
methods.description: Reads and parses the session store JSON file based on configuration.

methods.name: makeWhatsAppElevatedCfg
methods.description: Creates a configuration object with WhatsApp elevated permissions and optional group mention requirement.

methods.name: runDirectElevatedToggleAndLoadStore
methods.description: Simulates toggling elevated permissions and loads session store, returning result and store.

methods.name: expectInlineCommandHandledAndStripped
methods.description: Tests that an inline command is handled and stripped correctly, verifying block reply and prompt content.

methods.name: runGreetingPromptForBareNewOrReset
methods.description: Mocks and tests greeting prompt behavior for /new or /reset commands.

methods.name: installTriggerHandlingE2eTestHooks
methods.description: Sets up afterEach hook to reset mocks and snapshots after each test.

methods.name: mockRunEmbeddedPiAgentOk
methods.description: Mocks runEmbeddedPiAgent to resolve with a specified text payload.

methods.name: createBlockReplyCollector
methods.description: Creates a collector object to gather block reply messages during tests.
